mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) can potentiate sympathomimetic effects of thyroid hormones, increasing risk of hypertensive crisis, arrhythmias, and cardiovascular complications, particularly in hyperthyroid states.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely; ensure levothyroxine dose is optimized to euthyroid state before or during MAOI therapy; consider alternative antidepressant if possible.
